core_message: The MOAB proved that devastating blast power comes not from heavy steel casings, but from pure, concentrated explosive force.
title: How America built the 21,000-pound MOAB bomb in nine weeks
description:
In 2003, American engineers rushed to build the most destructive conventional weapon in the United States military arsenal. Designed to crush underground cave networks and break enemy morale, the GBU-43/B Massive Ordnance Air Blast was so enormous that no standard bomber could drop it.

From a skunkworks-style crash program using leftover parts to its combat debut in the mountains of Nangarhar, this is the story behind the Mother of All Bombs.

Key points:
- Why the Air Force needed a successor to the Vietnam-era Daisy Cutter
- How an unconventional airdrop system launched an eleven-ton weapon from a cargo plane
- The engineering secret behind its thin aluminum shell and massive blast yield
- The real results of its sole combat deployment in 2017

Based on the Wikipedia article "GBU-43/B MOAB" (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/GBU-43/B_MOAB), licensed CC BY-SA 4.0.
